newsitem.title: FINLAND: FINNISH SELIN SAYS IN MERGER TALKS WITH AKTIA BANK.
newsitem.headline: FINNISH SELIN SAYS IN MERGER TALKS WITH AKTIA BANK.

text.p: Finnish brokerage Erik Selin Bankers Ltd said in a statement on Monday its owners were in talks with Aktia Bank on a possible Aktia acquisition of Selin.
"The aim of the deal is to keep the Selin Finance companies as independent units with access to the Aktia capital base and its banking network," Selin said.
Under the deal, Erik Selin Bankers, its subsidiary Erik Selin Fund Management Ltd and a majority stake in the trading company Niles Trading Ltd would become part of Aktia.
"For Aktia the acquisition would mean a clearly enhanced profile in asset management and securities broking," Selin said.
Aktia released a similarily phrased statement.
Neither company gave a timetable or any other details of the planned acquisition.
